assets.title: Editable Closed Book Set
assets.description: Original three-book closed set, with 0.160 by 0.230 by 0.026 m pocket, 0.190 by 0.270 by 0.037 m reading and 0.220 by 0.300 by 0.045 m reference formats. Every book has a continuous front/back/spine wrap cover and an inset closed page block, with two separately editable named components sharing a bottom-centred origin. Plain low-saturation covers without titles or copied artwork. One kit ID, not three colour variants. Static closed display only, with no opening, page turning, readable text or physical simulation.

assets.title: Inclined Shelf Book Sorting Cart
assets.description: Original static book sorting cart with two ten-degree backward-inclined shelves, continuous rear backstops, side stops and low front retaining lips. A rigid low chassis, four fixed flat-tread caster assemblies, four continuous uprights and two raised side handles form one functional service cart. Named editable components remain separate. Actual closed-book bottom and rear-face contacts are validated at selected poses; no wheel rotation, steering, load rating or dynamic insertion is promised.
